feedback: D2 close call vs D3 examples: the D2 rule says unrequested background after any AI question counts as D2, but the D3 examples (69fff128, 66d9e5be) follow AI turns ending in a conditional request ('If you tell me where the pain is...'); the codebook should say whether such conditional requests count as 'the AI asked'. Short overall durations like 'started hurting yesterday' (69600cc8) or vague 'lately' (63e55f08) are hard to place between background duration and main complaint. In mental-health chats (6a0206ae) the line between main complaint and background is unclear. Fragmentary first messages (6a10664c 'I get this time time') are hard to judge for D1.

The 'AI asked' rule does not say whether 'If you tell me X, I can...' offers count as a question; this decided D2 vs D3 in 66d9e5be and 69fff128, whose messages the codebook itself lists as D3 examples although the AI had just invited more detail. Very short onset statements ('started hurting yesterday', 69600cc8) and vague 'lately' (63e55f08) are not clearly covered by the overall-duration rule. Named conditions that are the main complaint (eczema in 6acb95ac) could be read as health history. Implied questions such as 'I don't know if that means anything' (66d8e4c1) sit between M3 and M1. Whether causes/situations in mental-health chats (stressors in 6a0206ae) are main problem or background is unclear.

D2 close call ('AI asked but person shares a different, unrequested piece of background still counts as D2') conflicts with the D3 examples: in 69fff128 and 66d9e5be the AI turn just before ended with 'If you tell me where the pain is...', yet the codebook uses these exact replies as D3 examples. Unclear whether 'If you tell me X, I can...' counts as a real AI question. Vague timing words ('lately' in 63e55f08, 'I get this time time' in 6a10664c, 'started yesterday' in 69600cc8) are not clearly covered by the overall-duration rule. 'What if I am spitting blood' (671a8337) may be a real new symptom phrased as a what-if; the codebook does not say how to tell. For mental-health chats (6a0206ae) it is unclear whether stressors are the main complaint or background.
